WHEREAS, several departments of the City of North Little Rock (the "City") have open purchase orders issued in 2022 which were not commenced and outstanding budget balances in which expenditures were delayed until 2023, and the North Little Rock City Council has found and determined that it is necessary and desirable to amend the 2023 Budget (adopted pursuant to Resolution No. 10425 on November 14, 2022) to reauthorize and include these additional expenditures for certain City Departments. NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF NORTH LITTLE ROCK, ARKANSAS: SECTION 1: That the 2023 Budget for the City of North Little Rock should be, and is hereby, amended to reauthorize and include additional expenditure for certain City Departments as itemized on Exhibit "A" attached hereto and incorporated herein by reference. SECTION 2: That funds for the subject expenditures are hereby appropriated pursuant to fund appropriation designations listed on Exhibit "A". SECTION 3: That all resolutions or parts of resolutions in conflict herewith are hereby repealed to the extent of the conflict. SECTION 4: That this Resolution shall be in full force and effect from and after its passage and approval. PASSED: 3/I3 SPONSOR: APPRL7WED: Mayor terry C. Hartwick ATTEST: Dia

parts.synopsis: An ordinance to authorize the City Manager to enter into a fourth contract amendment with Soundthinking, Inc. (formerly ShotSpotter, Inc.), for the renewal of the wide-area gunshot detection service and addition of case builder software for the Little Rock Police Department.
